summary: Full E2E testing of KRONOS ARENA. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests passed (root, status legacy POST/GET, rounds POST with persistence, leaderboard aggregation with wins/games/best_time, leaderboard limit, invalid payload 422). Frontend: lobby renders with KRONOS+ARENA titles, all required data-testids present (nickname-input, bots-slider, start-game-btn). Clicking start navigates to game-screen with game-canvas, countdown-overlay appears, after ~4s HUD shows hud-timer (TIMER 1:29), hud-survivors (5), hud-infected (1), hud-objective, hud-minimap. WASD keypresses ran for ~3s with zero JS/page errors. mute-toggle-btn toggles cleanly. exit-btn returns to lobby. Full backend<->frontend integration confirmed (TEST_NICK from pytest visible in lobby TOP_SURVIVORS leaderboard).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') - consider migrating to FastAPI lifespan handler (non-blocking)
/api/leaderboard 'best_time' uses $max on survived_seconds which is actually 'longest survived seconds' - naming is consistent with semantics here; no action needed
RoundResultCreate lacks field validation (e.g., role enum, non-negative seconds). Low priority since it's a single-player client-only submission.
seed_data_creation: Pytest created 3 rounds under TEST_NICK_<ts> and 1 status_checks entry TEST_kronos_client. Visible in leaderboard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest). Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Frontend public URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Game countdown is ~3s; wait >=4s after start-game-btn click before asserting HUD. Audio requires user gesture and is not testable in headless - skip.
